limits: Recorded label orientation, not biological occupancy, causal vertical effect or actual altitude.
DLT 2018 superseded vintage; DSM elevation includes surface objects; observation interactions remain.
Post-pilot matched sensitivity, not independent ecological replication.
LC100 fractions are areas of classified open/closed forest types, not DLT leaf cover; four fixed fractions including mixed/other.

summary.interpretation: Positive incremental information conditional on fixed LC100 forest-class fractions and DSM surface-topography proxies; not causal vertical filtering, actual DLT leaf fractions or an independent biological replication. Adding forest-class covariates to T does not itself improve absolute held-out prediction, and TL+R50 scores below T+R50. Keep all models; no best-model selection.
